framework: Spring AI Alibaba ReactAgent 1.1.2.0 / Spring AI 1.1.2
credentialBoundary: RunnableConfig trusted metadata -> native ToolContext -> business Authorization header; absent from model definitions
apiIntegration: Five independent annotated host methods -> Spring AI ToolCallbacks; no Cyrene tool/parser/runtime dependency
timingLimit: Automated JVM initialization, not human integration time; excluded from per-task duration

tools.name: listTasks
tools.description: List current user's tasks with stable cursor pagination. Follow pageInfo.nextCursor until hasMore=false. Optional customerId filters one customer. Results include id, status and version.

tools.name: updateTask
tools.description: Update an authorized task's status (open, inProgress, done) using its current expectedVersion. Read the version first; success increments version. Business system enforces ownership and optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: createTask
tools.description: Create a task for an authorized customer. All request fields are required; dueDate is YYYY-MM-DD. Repeating exactly the same idempotencyKey and body returns the same task, without another insert.

tools.name: getCustomer
tools.description: Read one customer using its returned business ID. Authorization is enforced by the business system for the current user.

tools.name: listCustomers
tools.description: List current user's customers with stable cursor pagination. Follow pageInfo.nextCursor until hasMore=false. expiresBefore and inactiveBefore are strict YYYY-MM-DD upper bounds. limit is the page size.
